svg.text: Curvature-regularized MBRL — current architecture (2026-06-08, post bridge runs 1–5)
src/mbrl: models/{encoder,dynamics,spectral,policy}.py, training/loop.py, regularization/{hutchinson,schedule}.py — status tags per claims_ledger.md
Environment
Pendulum / MuJoCo
(obs, a, r, obs′) → replay
Encoder (+ EMA targets)
z = LayerNorm(MLP(obs)) ∈ ℝᵏ
spectral rule: k ≤ 1·obs_dim (cap_mult=1)
MLP path: k ≤ 4·obs_dim (rule v2)
Latent dynamics — affine | gaussian
μ = z + f(z) + G(z)·a (d²μ/da² = 0, R15 — both modes)
gaussian: p(z′|z,a) = 𝒩(μ, diag σ²(z)), σ² state-only
L = NLL = ½⟨(z′−μ)²e^(−logσ²) + logσ²⟩; affine: L = ‖μ − z′_EMA‖²
Spectral reward stack — closed form, no Hutchinson on R (models/spectral.py)
Rolling cache (FIFO 4096)
x = [z.detach(), a (, τ)], y = symlog(r)
refit at |cache| ≥ M, then every refit_every updates
3 heads (independent W draws) = cheap exact ensemble
Bandwidth modes (sigma_w) — pick one
φⱼ(x) = √(2/M) cos(wⱼ·x + bⱼ), wⱼ ~ 𝒩(0, σ²₍ₖ₎I)
• fixed ladder [0.25…2] — run 3, +33.7%
• auto: rungs = σ*·[½,1,2,4], σ* = measured SNR=1
crossing — run 5 champion, +48.3%
• learned: W = W_base·exp(log_s)[block] — reward-fit
gradient through the pipes; c re-anchors per refit
σ* = 0.207±0.007 on the supervised proxy (stable to ~3%)
Band penalty (weights_mode) — validated: poly
poly: θⱼ(t) = Σ_d c_d · λ(t+s_d) · |wⱼ|^(2·deg_d) (high-clamp: [1,3], [0.1,10])
snr: θⱼ = (N/M)/SNR_band(j) — Wiener cutoff at SNR=1; incremental-residual
split-half estimate (naive version broken by signal leakage)
run 4: snr LOST as penalty (−23.8%) — kept as measurement; poly stays the control
RULE: λ(t) smooth floored decay only — refits have no inertia, λ≈0 ⇒ instant interpolator
Closed-form weighted ridge (one (M,M) solve / head / refit)
ĉ = (ΦᵀΦ + diag(θ) + εI)⁻¹ Φᵀ y, R(x) = Σⱼ ĉⱼ φⱼ(x)
~0.04 s wall; sweeps O(10³)× faster than 1500 Adam epochs + Hutchinson
Exact curvature penalty — diagonal in frequency space
E‖∇²R‖²_F = E(ΔR)² = (1/M) Σⱼ ĉⱼ² |wⱼ|⁴ (null-Lagrangian equivalence, exact-in-expectation)
feeds auto-dose + the adaptive imagination-horizon certificate unchanged; verified against autograd Hutchinson (tests)
SNR diagnostics logged live: spectral/sigma_star, sigma_at_snr1, snr_min/max, sigma_scale_k (learned)
checkpointing: config-hash-scoped lineages; calibrated/learned bases restored bitwise on resume
z⊥, a, symlog(r)
Stochastic penalty (MLP reward / optional dynamics)
Hutchinson: E_v ‖∇²R·v‖², v ~ Rademacher, 2 probes
clamped Lap-2: max((v₁ᵀHv₁)(v₂ᵀHv₂), 0)
+41 / −40 / −79 ordering (report §3); the clamp's closed-
form analog is still open — positivity alone refuted (run 1),
wide+sharp transverse cuts supported (run 2, ρ=+0.63)
L = L_dyn + L_rew(MLP) + λ(t)·pen; gaussian dyn:
Hessian probes on mean(z,a), never on samples
Behaviour — stochastic imagination
z_{t+1} ~ p(·|z_t, π(z_t)) (gaussian: rsample, grads flow;
affine: deterministic)
r̂ = symexp(clamp(R([z, π(z)]), ±m·B)), B data-driven
policy ↑ G^λ − pessimism·std + entropy; value ↓ ‖V−G^λ‖²
adaptive horizon H ≤ 25: grows only as the exact penalty
EMA certifies low curvature (R15: horizons are purchased)
acting: π runs in the env → replay closes the loop
R(x), exact pen
Evidence ledger (supervised proxy, scripts/bridge_experiment.py — RL validation = colab_spectral, 5 arms, pending)
run 1: pointwise-positivity Gram penalty — NOT SUPPORTED 0/9 (data-null directions). run 2: hybrid wide+sharp cuts 7/9; benefit tracks ∠(diag, Gram), ρ=+0.63 (bandwidth confound open).
run 3: σ-ladder × λ-poly +33.7% (10/10), +Gram +36.8%. run 4: explicit Wiener weights −23.8% (kept as measurement; σ* crossing ≠ 1 — hypothesis falsified, crossing = 0.207±0.007).
run 5: SNR-CALIBRATED ladder (σ*·[½,1,2,4]) + λ-poly = +48.3% (10/10) — current champion. Untested: sigma_w=learned, model.dynamics=gaussian (conjecture tier).
Weil-positivity identification: conjecture tier, user-authorized firewall crossing; first concrete prediction (run 1) failed as stated — any claim must say so.
Lineage: Tancik 2020 (RFF/NTK bandwidth) · BARF (frequency curricula) · spectral filtering (Rosasco) · Li & Pathak 2021 (Fourier features in RL) — docs/related_work_spectral.md
Symbols
M = n_features (512) · θ = per-feature ridge weights · λ(t) = schedule (cuberoot, floor 10⁻⁵ on spectral) · σ* = measured SNR=1 crossing · symlog r = sign(r)·log(1+|r|)
Φ ∈ ℝ^{N×M} · H = ∇²R in (z, a, τ) coords · γ, λ_r = discount, return mixing · ε = 10⁻⁸ floor · B = running max |symlog r| · τ = task one-hot
Closed-form chain: bandwidth mode fixes the pipes → θ doses the bands through training → one linear solve per refit → exact penalty certifies the horizon → stochastic imagination spends it.
